A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the spinal cord in adult zebrafish is not a dead‐end.
zebrafish are able to regenerate their spinal cord after injury, but the regeneration of axons from the spinal cord to the brain is not as robust as regeneration of axons in the opposite direction.
